== OOT Spawn Tables ==

Island with Temple on north side of hill and old ruined tower on top of hill inhabited by Elesseryl Terussar who sells Mage spells, mostly summoning spells. 

Location - (1008, -8022)

Placeholders: [[a pirate]], [[a cyclops]]*, [[Boog Mudtoe]], [[an aqua goblin]]. [https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=435923]

Respawn Timer: 6 minutes

Path: Around a minute after spawning the spawn will path around the island (as of 2024-10-23)

Patch 2024-10-23 [https://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=435923] brought in changes that removed the second cyclops spawn from the island. The placeholder or an ancient cyclops will now path around the island after spawning. A goblin PH was added to the list of possible spawns.

The below information is no longer true as the second spawn has been removed.

<s>*There are 2 cyclops that spawn on that island. 1 spawns and wanders on the side of the island closest to Seafury Island, while the other spawns and wanders on the side closest to Sister Island. The cyclops that spawns and STANDS STILL is the PH for the AC.</s>

<s>It is also thought that any cyclops can be a placeholder for AC, some have confirmed this is true on p99 also.  [http://www.project1999.com/forums/showthread.php?t=123033]
*Cyclops that wanders the island is on a 22min timer, thus far after 10ish kills it only seems to be a cyclops and none of the other PH's.



*As of August 22, 2015, on Red99, there are two spawns. One wandering cyclops, and one stationary. The wandering cyclops is always a cyclops, and is on a longer respawn timer. The stationary spawn is the PH for the ancient cyclops, and can be any of the mobs listed above.</s>
